messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGERDUTY: P1 - GPU_POOL_EXHAUSTION for cluster acme-nyc-private. Autoscaler failed to add nodes. Affected: Acme Health prod (3 services degraded). Incident INC-2026-351 created. page: @Maya Chen, @Infra Oncall
Maya Chen: ack, I'm on it. Can someone paste current queue length and the autoscaler logs?
Sam Patel: queue ~410 waiting requests across 3 pods (observed at ingress). Throughput dropped 90%.
André Fournier: autoscaler logs show repeated failures provisioning nodes: "CreateInstanceQuotaExceeded" then "InstanceCreationTimedOut". Also image pulls stalled on new nodes.
Maya Chen: copying relevant logs from autoscaler:
```
E0321 14:02:12 autoscaler.go:278] failed to create instance: quota exceeded: GPU quota 8->0 available
E0321 14:03:05 autoscaler.go:299] create instance timed out after 2m0s for nodegroup-acme-nyc-gpu
E0321 14:04:01 autoscaler.go:411] backoff preventing further attempts for 4m30s
```
Infra Oncall: I'm jumping in. Checking nodepool state and cloud quota now.
ops-bot: Observability summary: GPU utilization 98%, schedulable capacity 0, pending pods 128 (not 410, Sam where are you counting?).
Sam Patel: 410 was ingress queued requests; pending pods 128 is kube pending jobs. sorry for mixed metrics.
Karen (CS): Customer reports latency >30s and timeouts on batch inference jobs. They're getting paged.
Maya Chen: immediate mitigations: 1) enable cross-cluster fallback to hosted pool, 2) manual scale attempt of nodegroup, 3) ask infra to request emergency quota bump. Which can we do fastest?
Infra Oncall: I can flip fallback routing now (2-3 mins) to relieve customer load. Manual scale returns error: cloud API: "preflight checks failed: imagePullBackOff rate-limited". Quota bump needs cloud support, ETA unknown.
André Fournier: image pull throttling on private nodes seems to be from our internal registry rate limits. New nodes fail to pull large model artifacts ~10GB each. Suggest mounting shared NFS cache or use pre-baked AMI to avoid pulls.
Maya Chen: can we temporarily route inbound requests to hosted Redwood inference for this customer? We need to gate risk.
Infra Oncall: yes - initiating canary route shift for Acme Health (route->hosted) now. This will preserve request fidelity but costs more.
ops-bot: Route change initiated. Monitoring latency and error rates.
(2 minutes pass)
ops-bot: Route change complete. Acme Health request volume on private cluster fell ~88%. Hosted pool is handling ~120 qps for them. Latency back to acceptable for most requests.
Karen (CS): Customer notified about failover to hosted with temporary increase in egress/cost. They asked for ETA to return to private cluster.
Maya Chen: Next steps to restore private capacity: 1) avoid image pulls by creating a pre-baked AMI with the model artifacts, 2) re-run nodegroup create using that AMI, 3) temporarily lift node creation backoff. Who can build AMI?
André Fournier: I can kick off AMI bake. It will take ~18-25 minutes to build and replicate to region. Once baked, we can spin up nodes without heavy pulls.
Sam Patel: while AMI bakes, we should clear pending pods that are stuck for reasons unrelated to GPU by rescheduling or deleting stuck init containers. I'll triage the top 20 pending pods and restart.
Maya Chen: agree. Also remove autoscaler backoff to attempt limited manual creates once AMI is available. Don't exceed 2 nodes at a time to avoid churn.
Infra Oncall: filed emergency quota request with cloud support (ticket CLOUD-9987). Marked as urgent. If quota comes through we can immediately add nodes using AMI.
pagerduty-bot: Note: oncall handoff scheduled in 50m. Current responder: Maya Chen. Next: Infra Oncall.
(10 minutes pass)
André Fournier: AMI bake started. logs:
```
[AMI] packer: downloading model artifact shard-0 (10.5GB)
[AMI] packer: download complete
[AMI] repack: creating snapshot and AMI id ami-0acme12345
```
Sam Patel: I cleared 26 stuck pods (init timeout). Pending count dropped 128 -> 94. In-flight queue on private cluster decreased slightly but still not healthy.
Maya Chen: good. Once AMI done, Infra Oncall, please try manual scale of +3 nodes with 30s stagger.
Infra Oncall: will do. If node create fails, fallback is to keep routing to hosted until we confirm stable nodes.
(20 minutes later)
Infra Oncall: AMI replicated. Creating nodes using ami-0acme12345. First node joined cluster, kubelet reports GPU drivers loaded. Second node join completed. Third node creation timed out - cloud API rate-limited create (we're hitting account create-per-minute). Manual retry queued.
ops-bot: New nodes available: 2. GPU schedulable capacity increased ~2.5%. Pending pods dropped 94 -> 54. Request latency improving.
Maya Chen: keep manual retry for third node. Also modify autoscaler to use new AMI imageTemplate so future autoscale events don't trigger heavy pulls.
Sam Patel: adjusted autoscaler nodegroup config to ami=ami-0acme12345 and set max surge 2.
André Fournier: note: long-term fix: push model artifacts to a regional cache and add pre-warm jobs. Also request an increase in model artifact pull concurrency limits with registry team.
Karen (CS): Customer wants a post-incident writeup and confirmation on SLA impact window. Can we estimate total affected window?
Maya Chen: we declared P1 at 14:00 UTC (thread_ts). Failover to hosted at ~14:03. Partial recovery on private cluster at ~14:30 with 2 nodes added. We'll aim to finalize remediation and full private return by 15:00 after autoscaler validation.
Karen (CS): customer ack'd timeline and appreciates quick failover.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-351 severity updated to P1 -> P1 (mitigating). Actions: follow-up RCA, AMI bake permanent, registry concurrency limits, quota request tracking CLOUD-9987.
Maya Chen: handing off to Infra Oncall for next 1h to watch autoscaler and cloud API rate limits. Infra Oncall: take it.
Infra Oncall: taking over. I'll keep monitoring and will update thread every 15 minutes or on state change.
Maya Chen: thanks team. Will prepare RCA draft and signal to customer for postmortem.
ops-bot: incident status: Mitigated (customer routed to hosted fallback). Ongoing: restore private pool autoscale and quota.
(End of thread)
